description: Export existing issues with their captured evidence and discussion to an explicitly chosen connected tracker destination. Uses the same product export and retry handlers. Inspect every result: pending or partial attachment delivery is not success. Read the saved export status after uncertain outcomes before retrying.

context.description: One sentence on why you are calling this tool, for OverlayQA product analytics. Describe the purpose only (for example "checking the checkout page for contrast issues"). Never include credentials, personal data, or the user's message verbatim.

destination.description: Explicit destination fields from the destination discovery results; no first/default destination is selected

metadata.description: Optional destination fields from the provider schema, such as status or assignee

name: export_issues
